facts.business: DCM Financial Services Limited is a financial services company dealing with debentures, fixed deposits, and property investments, currently under a court-appointed One Man Committee scheme for stakeholder payments.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (i) Non-provision of Rs 1,683 Lakhs interest on debentures and fixed deposits per One Man Committee scheme, and misclassification of Rs 7.35 lakhs interest paid as finance cost instead of prior period item; (ii) Non-creation of Debenture Redemption Reserve of Rs 2,014.98 Lakhs for 'B' series debentures due to insufficient profits; (iii) Unascertained depletion in value of assets charged as security to banks/debenture-holders/financial institutions; (iv) Lack of balance confirmations for security deposits, trade receivables, bank balances, borrowings, related party balances, and other receivables/payables; (v) Contingent liability of Rs 288.29 lacs pending arbitration with NBCC Ltd.

key_risks: Non-provision of interest liability of Rs 1,683 Lakhs as per court-approved scheme
Non-creation of Debenture Redemption Reserve of Rs 2,014.98 Lakhs
Potential depletion in value of secured assets not ascertained
Absence of balance confirmations for major assets and liabilities
Contingent liability of Rs 288.29 lacs in arbitration with NBCC Ltd
Time-barred debts not separately ascertained or provided for
facts.related_party_note: Balance confirmations not received for balances payable to related parties (refer Note 39 and Auditor's qualification (iv))
